description: The V0.7b development scenario suite: the five practices of dreamteam-dev version 2 (radiologist overtime paid), each with a solvency setting (finance.solvency; docs/V0.7_SOLVENCY_DESIGN.md) in two variants: a $50,000 credit line at 10% a year (-credit), and no credit (-nocredit). Discretionary commitments must fit in the funding headroom (cash plus undrawn credit, less current liabilities and reserved commitments). Not a held-out benchmark set; no score, no ranking. Specification: docs/BENCHMARK_SUITE.md.
